parser.implementation: Rust universal-schema ISO 10303 Part-21 reader; no OCCT dependency

solid_consumer.implementation: Rust vcad B-rep kernel STEP reader; no OCCT dependency

consumer_mesh_diagnostic.authority: bounded diagnostic only; OCCT Layer-C B-rep metrics remain strict contract checks

refusal_policy: invalid/open/non-solid, non-positive material, excessive topology tolerance, missing body, unit/schema/parser/consumer disagreement are explicit rejection/unqualification conditions; no tolerance widening, healing-after-export, body dropping, or tessellated substitution is permitted
provenance_policy: every emitted STEP is SHA-256 digested and bound in campaign evidence to fixture source, exporter profile id, expected body set, and independent parser/consumer observations
